lease_assignment_rules._comment: USMCA HAS NOT BEGUN OPERATING (owner, 2026-07-29: plates and IRP are ~2 weeks out). This rule stays INACTIVE until the owner turns it on. `active_from` was REMOVED, not updated to a guessed date: resolveLeaseCompanyId() treats a PAST active_from as an override that re-enables the rule even when active=false, so the stale 2026-07-01 value meant this rule already returned the USMCA id on every ingest despite reading as off. With no active_from, active:false genuinely blocks and the resolver returns null. To activate when USMCA is really operating, set active:true (do not re-add a date).
